newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends dull session up, near highs.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends dull session up, near highs.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed firmer and just beneath session highs, but most-active July failed to rally above resistance, trading sources said.
The contract climbed to a recent high of 11.22 cents a lb on light fund buying, lingered on both sides of unchanged throughout the afternoon, and drifted slightly higher on the close.
Fund buying was also noted in the October contract, traders said.

Benchmark July settled 0.03 cent firmer at 11.21 cents after trading from 11.15 to a one-week high of 11.22 cents. Second-position October closed 0.06 cent higher at 11.01 cents, while the rest settled up 0.05 to 0.07 cent.

While the market has crept steadily higher, it is not expected to sustain gains without support from the fundamental side, analysts said. A lack of physical offtake or other inspiring news will keep prices under pressure, they added.
Nearby support remained at 11.05 and 11.00 cents for July sugar, followed by 10.85 cents. Major resistance was cited at 11.50 cents.
Open interest in July fell 918 lots to 74,330 lots as of early Wednesday, CSCE said.
An estimated 17,462 lots changed hands on the day, compared to Wednesday's official 13,629 lots.
